Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.

# Conservative Party Manifesto 2024 Summary

## Economic Policy
The manifesto proposes cutting employee National Insurance from 12% to 6% by April 2027 and abolishing self-employed National Insurance entirely. The party commits to not raising income tax, VAT, or corporation tax. A "Triple Lock Plus" would ensure state pensions and pensioner tax allowances rise with the highest of inflation, earnings, or 2.5%.

## Taxation and Families
Child Benefit would shift to a household-based system, with withdrawal beginning at £120,000 combined income. Working parents would receive 30 hours of free childcare weekly from nine months until school age.

## Immigration
A legal cap on migration would be introduced with annual parliamentary votes. The Rwanda removal scheme would continue for illegal migrants. Visa fees would increase, and health checks would be required for migrants before travel.

## Defence and Security
Defence spending would reach 2.5% of GDP by 2030, with £10 billion invested in munitions production. A National Defence and Resilience Plan would be developed.

## Housing
The party targets 1.6 million new homes, with permanent Stamp Duty abolition for first-time buyers on homes up to £425,000 and a new Help to Buy scheme.

## Health and Education
NHS spending would increase above inflation annually, with 92,000 more nurses and 28,000 more doctors planned. A mandatory National Service programme would offer 18-year-olds military or civic service options. 100,000 new apprenticeships would be funded by closing underperforming university courses.

## Energy and Environment
Annual North Sea oil and gas licensing rounds would continue. The party commits to net zero by 2050 while guaranteeing no new green levies. Small Modular Reactor fleets would be approved.

## Transport
The £2 bus fare cap would continue. £36 billion from HS2 savings would fund regional transport projects. Road pricing would be banned.
